question: What claim of instruction is being made by the speaker who promises to tell the method of names to the beautiful-eyed one?
premises: The speaker will speak the method of names of them.
The addressee is urged to hear.
The address is to the beautiful-eyed one.
inference: The speaker promises to declare the method of their names and urges the beautiful-eyed one to hear it.
uncertainties: The referent of 'them' is not recoverable from this verse alone.
plain_english: I shall speak the method of their names; hear, O beautiful-eyed one.
